title: The Boom, the Bust, and the Cost of the Cleanup: Abandoned Oil and Gas Wells in Pennsylvania and Implications for Shale Gas Governance
abstract: This chapter considers the important question of what happens to wells, and whether the economic incentives are appropriately designed for inducing socially efficient behavior. State governments require operators of oil and gas wells to reclaim well sites at the end of a well's economic life. To encourage and fund proper reclamation, states require operators to set aside money in the form of a bond, which is forfeited to the state if the operator abandons a well without reclaiming it to state standards. The state can then use the money to pay contractors for reclamation. Estimates of the cost of reclaiming shale gas wells suggests that current bonding requirements are too low, especially in Pennsylvania. The chapter uses the relationships between well characteristics and reclamation costs to provide a better estimate of the cost of reclaiming the typical shale gas well in Pennsylvania.
abstract_zh: 本章探讨了一个重要问题：废弃油气井会发生什么，以及经济激励是否经过恰当设计，以促使社会有效率的行为。州政府要求油气井运营商在油井经济寿命结束时对井场进行复垦。为鼓励并资助妥善复垦，各州要求运营商以保证金的形式预留资金，若运营商在未按州标准复垦的情况下弃井，该保证金将被没收给州政府。随后，州政府可用这笔资金支付承包商的复垦费用。对页岩气井复垦成本的估计表明，目前的保证金要求过低，在宾夕法尼亚州尤为如此。本章利用井的特征与复垦成本之间的关系，对宾夕法尼亚州典型页岩气井的复垦成本给出了更好的估计。

title: Farming, Fracking, and Water
How Local Economic Conditions Affect School Finances, Teacher Quality, and Student Achievement: Evidence from the Texas Shale Boom
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: Whether improved local economic conditions lead to better student outcomes is theoretically ambiguous and will depend on how schools use additional revenues and how students and teachers respond to rising private sector wages. The Texas boom in shale oil and gas drilling, with its large and localized effects on wages and the tax base, provides a unique opportunity to address this question that spans the areas of education, labor markets, and public finance. An empirical approach using variation in shale geology across school districts shows that the boom reduced test scores and student attendance, despite tripling the local tax base and creating a revenue windfall. Schools spent additional revenue on capital projects and debt service, but not on teachers. As the gap between teacher wages and private sector wages grew, so did teacher turnover and the percentage of inexperienced teachers, which helps explain the decline in student achievement. Changes in student composition did not account for the achievement decline but instead helped to moderate it. The findings illustrate the potential value of using revenue growth to retain teachers in times of rising private sector wages.
abstract_zh: 改善的地方经济状况是否会带来更好的学生成果，在理论上是不确定的，这取决于学校如何使用额外收入，以及学生和教师如何应对私营部门工资的上涨。得克萨斯州的页岩油气钻探热潮，因其对工资和税基产生的巨大且局部性的影响，为从教育、劳动力市场和公共财政等多个领域探讨这一问题提供了独特机会。利用页岩地质条件在学区间的差异进行的实证分析表明，尽管繁荣使当地税基增加了两倍并带来了收入意外之财，但它降低了考试成绩和学生出勤率。学校将额外收入用于资本项目和债务偿还，而非教师薪酬。随着教师工资与私营部门工资之间的差距扩大，教师流动率以及经验不足教师的比例也随之上升，这有助于解释学生成绩的下降。学生构成的变化并不能解释成绩下降，反而有助于缓解这一下降。研究结果说明，在私营部门工资上涨时期，利用收入增长留住教师可能具有潜在价值。

title: How Should We Think about Environmental Policy and Jobs? An Analogy with Trade Policy and an Illustration from U.S. Coal Mining
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Public discussions of environmentally motivated policies include much confusing talk about job loss. Does job loss in a polluting industry mean that others should endure dirty air or that complementary policies are needed? To clarify the jobs issue, I use concepts from research on international trade policy and its effects and apply them to recent job loss in the U.S. coal industry. The case of coal illustrates the economic adjustment that could arise from an environmental policy as well as the equity, efficiency, and political issues that adjustment raises. I show that for each coal job lost, earnings in the surrounding county fell by nearly $100,000, and that one-third of those who lost jobs did not move and remained unemployed. On average, the losses affected poorer counties and exacerbated income disparities between counties. Concurrently, coal county voters shifted toward pro-coal candidate Donald Trump in the 2016 U.S. presidential election, helping him win Pennsylvania. More broadly, I argue that environmental adjustment assistance of some form may improve the equity and political feasibility of environmental policies that benefit many but harm some. However, the how and when of such assistance requires further study.
abstract_zh: 关于环境驱动型政策的公共讨论中，充斥着许多令人困惑的关于就业流失的论调。污染行业的就业流失是否意味着其他人应当忍受污浊的空气，还是需要配套的政策？为厘清就业问题，我运用了国际贸易政策及其影响研究中的概念，并将其应用于美国煤炭行业近期的就业流失。煤炭案例说明了环境政策可能引发的经济调整，以及该调整所带来的公平、效率和政治问题。我发现，每失去一个煤炭工作岗位，其周边县的收入就下降近10万美元，而失业者中有三分之一没有迁移，仍处于失业状态。平均而言，这些损失影响了较贫困的县，并加剧了县际收入差距。与此同时，煤炭县的选民在2016年美国总统选举中转向支持亲煤候选人唐纳德·特朗普，帮助他赢得了宾夕法尼亚州。更广泛地说，我认为某种形式的环境调整援助可能有助于提升那些使多数人受益、但使少数人受损的环境政策的公平性和政治可行性。然而，此类援助的具体方式和时机仍需进一步研究。

title: Environmental Hazards and Local Investment: A Half-Century of Evidence from Abandoned Oil and Gas Wells
abstract: Influential studies that generally cover a few years find that environmental hazards reduce property values and welfare. Over decades, however, hazards may further harm neighborhoods by discouraging investment. This paper exploits the quasi-random assignment of oil and gas wells that were and were not properly decommissioned (plugged) in a county in Western Pennsylvania. Over half a century, the two acres around unplugged wells had roughly half as much building as the area around plugged wells. Evidence suggests this reduction stems from disincentives to invest and not from poorer households sorting to properties near unplugged wells.
abstract_zh: 大量研究（通常只涵盖几年）发现，环境危害会降低房产价值和福利。然而，经过数十年，危害可能会因抑制投资而进一步损害社区。本文利用宾夕法尼亚州西部一个县中，油气井是否被妥善封堵（plugged）而被准随机分配的情况进行研究。经过半个世纪，未封堵井周围两英亩范围内的建筑面积约为封堵井周围的一半。证据表明，这种减少源于投资激励的减弱，而并非贫困家庭迁入未封堵井附近的房产。

title: Does Resource Ownership Matter? Oil and Gas Royalties and the Income Effect of Extraction
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We study how subsurface ownership shapes the income effects of oil and gas extraction. For the average US county with growth in extraction from 2000 to 2014, we find that royalty income and its multiplier effect accounted for 70% of the total income gain, with each royalty dollar generating an additional 49 cents of local income. A county where residents own the subsurface captured 28 cents more of each dollar in production than one with absentee ownership. Nationally, oil and gas production increased US personal income in 2014 by $67 billion (0.5%) more than if all royalties accrued abroad. Areas with the same resource abundance can therefore experience contrasting economic outcomes because of differences in ownership.
abstract_zh: 我们研究地下产权归属如何影响油气开采的收入效应。对于2000至2014年间产量有所增长的美国普通县，我们发现，特许权使用费收入及其乘数效应占总收入增长的70%，每一美元的特许权使用费可带来49美分的额外本地收入。在居民拥有地下资源产权的县，每一美元产量中比外部所有权的县多留存28美分。在全国范围内，2014年石油和天然气生产使美国个人收入比所有特许权使用费都流向海外的情形多增加670亿美元（0.5%）。因此，资源丰度相同的地区，可能因产权归属的不同而经历截然不同的经济结果。

title: Fracking and Radon: Spurious Correlation or Cause for Concern?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Unconventional oil and gas development (fracking) is controversial in large part because of environmental and health concerns. We consider one concern and revisit the estimated association between fracking and radon in nearby homes. We find that published estimates are sensitive to modest changes in sample definition or model specification. Further exploitation of rich spatial and temporal variation in drilling and radon testing reveals that drilling occurred in areas that had higher pre-existing radon levels. Models accounting for the confounding correlation give a precisely estimated zero effect of wells on radon concentrations in nearby buildings. Our study illustrates the value of revisiting published estimates but also its challenges. The time and effort required to access confidential data from the original provider can be considerable and even increase following a headline-making publication, as occurred in our case.
abstract_zh: 非常规油气开发（水力压裂，即fracking）因环境和健康问题而颇具争议。我们考察了其中一项担忧，并重新审视了已发表研究中水力压裂与附近住宅氡气之间的关联估计。我们发现，已发表的估计对样本定义或模型设定的适度变化很敏感。进一步利用钻井和氡检测在空间和时间上丰富的变异，发现钻井发生在原本氡浓度就较高的地区。考虑到这种混杂相关性的模型给出的结果是：井对附近建筑物氡浓度的影响估计精确地为零。我们的研究说明了重新审视已发表估计的价值，同时也说明了其中的挑战。从原始数据提供方获取机密数据所需的时间和精力可能相当可观，并且在一项引起轰动的发表之后甚至可能增加，本案例便是如此。

title: Local Labor Markets and Natural Resources: A Synthesis of the Literature
abstract: A primary way that natural resources affect a locality is through the demand for labor, with greater extraction requiring more workers. Shifts in labor demand can be measured through changes in employment and earnings, the main labor market outcomes, or through changes in the population and income, more generally. These changes may spillover into the nonresource economy, leading to greater overall effects or possibly crowd out; be spread unequally across the population, thereby altering the distribution of income and the poverty rate; or influence educational attainment, as people choose between additional schooling and work. In this review, the literature linking natural resources to local labor markets is synthesized by organizing existing studies according to their resource measurement and the outcomes that they consider. This synthesis provides an accessible guide to a literature that has boomed in recent years. It also identifies promising avenues for future research and lays a foundation to further generalize the evidence through an eventual meta‐analysis.
abstract_zh: 自然资源影响一个地方的主要途径，是通过劳动力需求：开采量越大，需要的工人就越多。劳动力需求的变化可以通过就业和收入的变化（即主要的劳动力市场结果）来衡量，或更广泛地通过人口和收入的变化来衡量。这些变化可能外溢到非资源经济中，从而产生更大的总体效应，或产生挤出效应；也可能在人口中分布不均，从而改变收入分配和贫困率；还可能影响教育程度，因为人们需要在额外的学校教育与工作之间作出选择。在本综述中，我们按资源度量方式和所考察的结果对现有研究进行归类，对连接自然资源与地方劳动力市场的文献进行了梳理。这一综述为一个近年来蓬勃发展的文献提供了易于理解的指南。它还指出了未来研究的有前景的方向，并为未来通过元分析进一步推广证据奠定了基础。

title: When Externalities are Taxed: The Incidence and Effect of Pennsylvania's Impact Fee on Shale Gas Wells
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Natural Resource Ownership, Financial Gains, and Governance: The Case of Unconventional Gas Development in the UK and US
A Quantitative Description of State-Level Taxation of Oil and Gas Production in the Continental U.S.
Broadening Benefits from Natural Resource Extraction: Housing Values and Taxation of Natural Gas Wells as Property
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: We study the effects of the property tax base shock caused by natural gas drilling in the Barnett Shale in Texas—a state that taxes oil and gas wells as property. Over the boom and bust in drilling, housing appreciation closely followed the oil and gas property tax base, which expanded the total tax base by 23 percent at its height. The expansion led to a decline in property tax rates while maintaining or increasing revenues to schools. Overall, each $1 per student increase in the oil and gas property tax base increased the value of the typical home by $0.15. Some evidence suggests that the cumulative density of wells nearby may lower housing values, indicating that drilling could reduce local welfare without policies to increase local public revenues.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了得克萨斯州巴奈特页岩（Barnett Shale）天然气钻探所造成的财产税税基冲击的影响，得克萨斯州将油气井作为财产征税。在钻探热潮的繁荣与萧条期间，住房升值与油气财产税税基紧密同步，在其峰值时使总税基扩大了23%。这一扩张导致财产税率下降，同时维持或增加了对学校的税收收入。总体而言，学生人均油气财产税税基每增加1美元，典型住房的价值便增加0.15美元。一些证据表明，附近油井的累积密度可能会降低房产价值，这说明在没有增加地方公共收入的政策的情况下，钻探可能会降低当地福利。

title: Capturing Rents from Natural Resource Abundance: Private Royalties from U.S. Onshore Oil and Gas Production
abstract: Innovation-spurred growth in oil and gas production from shale formations led the U.S. to become the global leader in producing oil and natural gas. Because most shale is on private lands, drilling companies must access the resource through private lease contracts that provide a share of the value of production – a royalty – to mineral owners. We investigate the competitiveness of leasing markets by estimating how much mineral owners capture geologically-driven advantages in well productivity through a higher royalty rate. We estimate that the six major shale plays generated $39 billion in private royalties in 2014, however, there is limited pass-through of resource abundance into royalty rates. A doubling of the ultimate recovery of the average well in a county increases the average royalty rate by 2 percentage points (an 11 percent increase). The low pass-through is consistent with firms exercising market power in private leasing markets, and with uncertainty over the value of resource endowments. The finding suggests that policies affecting the cost of extraction likely have little effect on the share of the value of production captured by mineral owners.
abstract_zh: 创新推动了页岩地层石油和天然气产量的增长，使美国成为全球石油和天然气生产的领导者。由于大多数页岩位于私人土地之上，钻探公司必须通过私人租赁合同获取资源，而这些合同会向矿产所有者提供产值的一部分，即特许权使用费（royalty）。我们考察了租赁市场的竞争性，估算矿产所有者通过更高的特许权使用费率，在多大程度上获取了地质条件带来的油井生产率优势。我们估计，2014年六大主要页岩区块产生了390亿美元的私人特许权使用费，然而，资源丰度向特许权使用费率的传导十分有限。一个县平均油井的最终采收量翻一番，平均特许权使用费率将提高2个百分点（增长11%）。这种较低的传导率与企业在私人租赁市场中行使市场势力相一致，也与资源禀赋价值的不确定性相一致。该发现表明，影响开采成本的政策对矿产所有者所获取的产值份额可能几乎没有影响。

title: Does Federal Crop Insurance Make Environmental Externalities from Agriculture Worse?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Farmers dramatically increased their use of federal crop insurance in the 2000s. From 2000 to 2013, premium subsidies increased sevenfold and acres enrolled increased by 77%. Although designed for nonenvironmental goals, subsidized insurance may affect the use of land, fertilizer, and agrochemicals and, therefore, environmental externalities from agriculture. Using novel panel data, we examine farmer responses to changes in coverage with an empirical approach that exploits program limits on coverage that were more binding for some farmers than for others. Estimates indicate that expanded coverage had little effect on the share of farmland harvested, crop specialization, productivity, or fertilizer and chemical use. More broadly, we construct and describe a new nationwide, farm-level panel data set with nearly 32,500 farms observed at least twice over the 2000–2013 period, a resource that should enrich US agro-environmental research.
abstract_zh: 2000年代，农民大幅增加了对联邦农作物保险的使用。2000年至2013年间，保费补贴增长了七倍，参保面积增长了77%。尽管该计划的设计初衷是实现非环境目标，但有补贴的保险可能影响土地、化肥和农用化学品的使用，进而影响农业带来的环境外部性。利用新的面板数据，我们采用一种实证方法考察农民对保障范围变化的反应，该方法利用了计划中的保障上限，这些上限对一些农民的约束比对另一些农民更为紧迫。估计结果表明，扩大保障范围对收获耕地的比例、作物专业化程度、生产率或化肥及化学品的使用量几乎没有影响。更广泛地看，我们构建并描述了一个全国性的农场层面新面板数据集，包含约32,500个农场，每个农场在2000–2013年间至少被观测两次，这一资源有望丰富美国农业环境研究。

title: Crop Prices, Agricultural Revenues, and the Rural Economy
abstract: Policy makers in the United States often justify agricultural subsidies by stressing that agriculture is the engine of the rural economy. We use the increase in crop prices in the late 2000s to estimate the marginal effect of increased agricultural revenues on local economies in the U.S. Heartland. We find that $1 more in crop revenue generated 64¢ in personal income, with most going to farm proprietors and workers (59%) or nonfarmers who own farm assets (36%). The evidence suggests a weak link between revenues and nonfarm income or employment, or on population. Cuts to agricultural subsidies are therefore likely to have little effect on the broader rural economy in regions like the Heartland.
abstract_zh: 美国政策制定者常以“农业是农村经济的引擎”为由为农业补贴辩护。我们利用2000年代末作物价格的上涨，估计农业收入增加对美国中部腹地（Heartland）地方经济的边际效应。我们发现，作物收入每增加1美元，便带来64美分的个人收入，其中大部分流向农场业主和工人（59%），或拥有农场资产的非农人口（36%）。证据表明，收入与非农收入或就业之间，以及与人口之间的联系较弱。因此，削减农业补贴对于像腹地这样地区的更广泛农村经济可能影响甚微。

title: Leveraging Wealth from Farmland Appreciation: Borrowing, Land Ownership, and Farm Expansion
abstract: We study how increases in wealth from rapid appreciation of farmland influenced farmer decisions to borrow, buy land, and expand. Exploiting periods of high and low appreciation and a panel data model that allows for correlation between prior growth trends and the share of land owned, we find that a dollar increase in paper wealth led younger farmers to increase real-estate-secured borrowing by 48 cents. Land purchases accompanied the increase in borrowing, supporting the view that collateral-based lending may be contributing to the recent runup in farmland prices. We find no effect of land wealth on production or acres harvested. (JEL Q15, R14)
abstract_zh: 我们研究农田快速升值带来的财富增长，如何影响农民的借贷、购地和扩张决策。利用升值高企与低迷的时期，并采用允许先前增长趋势与土地所有权份额相关的面板数据模型，我们发现纸面财富每增加1美元，会使年轻农民以房地产为抵押的借款增加48美分。借款增加的同时伴随着土地购买，这支持了一种观点，即以抵押品为基础的贷款可能正在推动近期农田价格的上涨。我们发现土地财富对产量或收获面积没有影响。（JEL Q15, R14）

title: What Can We Learn about Shale Gas Development from Land Values? Opportunities, Challenges, and Evidence from Texas and Pennsylvania
abstract: We study farm real estate values in the Barnett shale (Texas) and the northeastern part of the Marcellus shale (Pennsylvania and New York). We find that shale gas development caused appreciation in real estate values in both areas but the effect was much larger for the Marcellus, suggesting broader ownership of oil and gas rights by surface owners. In both regions, the greatest appreciation occurred when land was leased for drilling, not when drilling and production boomed. We find evidence that effects vary by farm type, which may reflect correlation between farm type and ownership of oil and gas rights.
abstract_zh: 我们研究得克萨斯州Barnett页岩区以及宾夕法尼亚州和纽约州东北部Marcellus页岩区的农场房地产价值。我们发现，页岩气开发在两个地区都带动了房地产价值的升值，但Marcellus地区的效应要大得多，这表明地表所有者更广泛地拥有石油和天然气权利。在两个地区，升值幅度最大的时点是土地签订钻探租约之时，而非钻探和生产热潮之时。我们发现效应因农场类型而异，这可能反映了农场类型与石油和天然气权利所有权之间的相关性。

title: A Decade of Natural Gas Development: The Makings of a Resource Curse?
Do Wealth Gains from Land Appreciation Cause Farmers to Expand Acreage or Buy Land?
abstract: Recent increases in farm real estate values in the United States have increased farm equity. By exploiting periods of high and low appreciation that caused various increases in wealth for farmers owning various shares of their farmland, we examine whether U.S. grain farmers expanded their acres harvested or acres owned in response to an increase in their land wealth. We find that land wealth had little effect on farm size. However, for similarly‐sized farms, a larger ownership share (10 percentage points) led to an increase in the growth of land owned (2 percentage points). Because older farmers own more of the land that they farm, greater land appreciation slows the rate at which younger farmers acquire land relative to older farmers.
abstract_zh: 近年来，美国农场房地产价值的上涨提高了农场权益。我们利用升值高低交替的时期——这些时期使拥有不同份额农田的农民财富以不同幅度增加——考察了美国谷物农民是否会因土地财富增加而扩大收获面积或增加所拥有的土地面积。我们发现，土地财富对农场规模的影响甚微。然而，对于规模相近的农场，所有权份额每高10个百分点，所拥有土地的增长率便提高2个百分点。由于年长农民所耕种的土地中自有土地的比例更高，更大幅度的土地升值会使年轻农民相对于年长农民获取土地的速度放缓。

title: Rural Wealth Creation and Emerging Energy Industries: Lease and Royalty Payments to Farms
Sustainable Rural Development and Wealth Creation: Five Observations Based on Emerging Energy Opportunities
abstract: In this article, the authors argue that better data and research on rural wealth creation are greatly needed and present a conceptual framework to help guide such research. The authors then discuss five observations about rural wealth creation, based on examples drawn from the recent literature on emerging energy industries in rural America. The cases show that the types of data needed to draw conclusions about wealth effects of new development are highly contextual. The framework can help researchers think about the types of data needed to assess policy.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，作者认为，关于农村财富创造的更好数据和研究亟需加强，并提出了一个概念框架以指导此类研究。随后，作者基于近期关于美国农村新兴能源产业的文献案例，讨论了关于农村财富创造的五项观察。案例表明，要就新开发项目的财富效应得出结论，所需数据类型高度依赖具体情境。该框架有助于研究者思考评估政策所需的数据类型。

title: Who Does Not Respond to the Agricultural Resource Management Survey and Does It Matter?
abstract: The Agricultural Resource Management Survey is the primary annual source of information on U.S. farms, but in a typical year one‐third of sampled farms do not respond. We use Census of Agriculture data to study nonresponse to the survey and how it affects estimates in two econometric models. Despite larger farms responding less, the coefficients estimated from the respondent subsample always fall inside confidence intervals based on draws from the full sample of respondents and nonrespondents. Although nonresponse bias can vary by application, the findings suggest that bias is unlikely to undermine conclusions based on econometrics using respondent data.
abstract_zh: 农业资源管理调查（Agricultural Resource Management Survey）是美国农场最主要的年度信息来源，但在通常年份中，三分之一的抽样农场不予作答。我们利用农业普查数据研究该调查的无应答问题，以及它如何影响两个计量经济模型中的估计结果。尽管规模较大的农场作答较少，但从作答者子样本估计出的系数，始终落在基于全部受访者与无应答者样本抽样所得的置信区间之内。尽管无应答偏误因应用场景而异，研究结果表明，该偏误不太可能推翻基于作答者数据的计量经济学结论。

title: Fair Trade-Organic Coffee Cooperatives, Migration, and Secondary Schooling in Southern Mexico
How Much Do Decoupled Payments Affect Production? An Instrumental Variable Approach with Panel Data
Keeping ARMS Relevant: Extracting Additional Information from ARMS
Social Learning and Technology Adoption: The Case of Coffee Pruning in Peru
The Economic Sustainability of Certified Coffee: Recent Evidence from Mexico and Peru
The Effects of a Natural Gas Boom on Employment and Income in Colorado, Texas, and Wyoming
Do ICDPs Work? An Empirical Evaluation of Forest-Based Microenterprises in the Brazilian Amazon
abstract: This paper evaluates public investments in forest-based microenterprises as part of an integrated conservation and development project (ICDP) in the Brazilian Amazon. We combine matching with regression to quantify the effects of program participation on household income, wealth, and livelihoods. We find that participation increased cash and total income and asset accumulation, suggesting that the microenterprises contributed to the development goals of the ICDP. There is no clear evidence, however, that the microenterprise program helped achieve the ICDP’s conservation goals of shifting household livelihoods away from agriculture and into sustainable forest use. (JEL O12, O13)
abstract_zh: 本文评估了作为巴西亚马逊地区综合保护与发展项目（ICDP）一部分的、针对森林类微型企业的公共投资。我们将匹配与回归相结合，以量化项目参与对家庭收入、财富和生计的影响。我们发现，参与提高了现金收入和总收入以及资产积累，表明微型企业促进了ICDP的发展目标。然而，没有明确证据表明该微型企业项目帮助实现了ICDP的保护目标，即将家庭生计从农业转向可持续的森林利用。（JEL O12, O13）
